description: Use this when the user wants to extract table from pdf, copy table from pdf, or inspect pdf to spreadsheet tables, before exporting: it shows each table's size, column types and first rows with no download. Does not make Excel or CSV files (use convert_pdf_tables for that), does not read scanned pages (no OCR), and handles up to 15 MB and 50 pages. Do not use for editing a PDF or for a PDF that is not a table.

file.description: The text-based PDF that holds the tables, e.g. report.pdf.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

merge_tables.description: true (default): join the last table on a page to the first on the next page only when their column count and whitespace-normalized source headers match.

pages.description: Pages to read, e.g. 1-3,5. Default: every page (first 50).

name: list_pdf_tables
title: List PDF tables
